selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, the service was active, listening on 0.0.0.0:8080, and returned HTTP 200 with the exact 19-byte response and matching content hash.
The systemd service was installed and enabled, then confirmed enabled and active after reboot.
Captured healthy baseline boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed the new boot ID, and directly verified recovered service, listener, file, and HTTP response.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
. /etc/os-release
printf 'os=%s version=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'init='; ps -p 1 -o comm=
printf 'python3='; command -v python3 || true
printf 'nginx='; command -v nginx || true
printf 'apache2='; command -v apache2 || true
printf 'listeners_8080:\n'; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )' || true

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /var/www/os-comparison
printf '%s' 'os-comparison-ready' > /var/www/os-comparison/index.html
chmod 0644 /var/www/os-comparison/index.html
cat > /etc/systemd/system/os-comparison-web.service <<'ANTRIEB_OS_COMPARISON_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=OS comparison static web service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=www-data
Group=www-data
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /var/www/os-comparison
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_OS_COMPARISON_UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now os-comparison-web.service
printf 'configured_service=os-comparison-web.service\n'

set -eu
expected=/run/os-comparison-expected
headers=/run/os-comparison-headers
body=/run/os-comparison-body
printf '%s' 'os-comparison-ready' > "$expected"
curl --noproxy '*' --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -D "$headers" -o "$body" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"
cmp "$expected" "$body"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled os-comparison-web.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active os-comparison-web.service
printf 'http_status='; awk 'NR==1 {print $2}' "$headers"
printf 'response='; cat "$body"; printf '\n'
printf 'response_bytes='; wc -c < "$body"
printf 'content_sha256='; sha256sum /var/www/os-comparison/index.html | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'response_sha256='; sha256sum "$body" | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'listener_8080:\n'; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )'
rm -f "$expected" "$headers" "$body"

commands.command:

printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 30 ]; do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet os-comparison-web.service && curl --noproxy '*' --fail --silent --max-time 2 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" >/dev/null; then
    printf 'recovery_ready_after_attempt=%s\n' "$attempt"
    exit 0
  fi
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  sleep 1
done
systemctl status os-comparison-web.service --no-pager || true
exit 1

set -eu
pre_boot_id='8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd'
post_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
[ "$post_boot_id" != "$pre_boot_id" ]
expected=/run/os-comparison-expected
headers=/run/os-comparison-headers
body=/run/os-comparison-body
printf '%s' 'os-comparison-ready' > "$expected"
curl --noproxy '*' --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -D "$headers" -o "$body" "http://$NODE_IP:8080/"
cmp "$expected" "$body"
printf 'pre_restart_boot_id=%s\n' "$pre_boot_id"
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\n' "$post_boot_id"
printf 'boot_id_changed=yes\n'
printf 'service_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled os-comparison-web.service
printf 'service_active='; systemctl is-active os-comparison-web.service
printf 'http_status='; awk 'NR==1 {print $2}' "$headers"
printf 'response='; cat "$body"; printf '\n'
printf 'response_bytes='; wc -c < "$body"
printf 'content_sha256='; sha256sum /var/www/os-comparison/index.html | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'response_sha256='; sha256sum "$body" | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'listener_8080:\n'; ss -ltnp '( sport = :8080 )'
rm -f "$expected" "$headers" "$body"
